description: This file defines the 'Tag' result class for the Coocook schema, including its columns, relationships, and a method to check if the tag is in use.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::Tag
classes.description: Represents the 'tags' table in the database schema, including relationships to projects, tag groups, articles, dishes, and recipes, as well as a method to check if the tag is in use.

methods.name: is_in_use
methods.description: Checks whether the tag is associated with any articles, dishes, or recipes by verifying if related results exist.
